candidate.answerReason: The uniform actual-to-model length factor is 100, so the volume factor is 100³. Thus the actual volume is 0.02 × 100³ = 20000 m³.

methods.label: Cube the length scale factor
methods.explanation: The ratio of lengths is \(1:100\), so the ratio of volumes is \(1:100^3=1:1000000\). Actual volume \(=0.02\times1000000=20000\text{ m}^3\).
methods.levelReason: Cubic volume scaling is explicitly covered by the supplied Grade 9 node; its numerical calculations use earlier arithmetic.
